# Penny Stock Analyser

> Free live due-diligence terminal for US and Canadian OTC, Pink Sheet, and sub-$5 penny stocks. Checks Chapter 11 bankruptcy Q-suffix status, live market quotes, 3-year annual financials (turnover, net profit/loss, and total debt), stock dilution risk, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory filings (US SEC EDGAR vs. Canadian SEDAR+ under SEC Rule 12g3-2(b)).

## Key Features
- **Live Bankruptcy Check**: Detects 5-letter Q-suffix tickers (`BBBYQ`, `SHLDQ`) indicating Chapter 11/7 bankruptcy proceedings.
- **Past 3 Years Financials**: Live annual Turnover (Revenue), Net Profit/(Loss), and Total Debt from official company filings via Yahoo Finance fundamentals feeds.
- **Direct Ticker Lookup URL**: Open any stock directly at `https://pennystockanalysertool.vercel.app/?ticker=TICKER` (for example, `https://pennystockanalysertool.vercel.app/?ticker=PLUG` or `https://pennystockanalysertool.vercel.app/?ticker=YOOIF`).
- **US vs. International Jurisdiction Detection**: Automatically distinguishes US SEC EDGAR issuers from Canadian TSX-V / CSE dual-listed foreign ordinaries (`F`-suffix tickers) that file on Canadian SEDAR+ (`sedarplus.ca`).
- **Zero Synthetic Data**: Never generates fake prices or simulated charts; links directly to Yahoo Finance, Google Finance, OTC Markets, SEC EDGAR, and SEDAR+.
